description: This file is a Java class implementation named ClientIdentifierReadPlatformServiceImpl. It is part of the org.apache.fineract.portfolio.client.service package and provides service methods for retrieving client identifier data from the database, including specific client identifiers and lists of identifiers. It interacts with the database using JdbcTemplate and implements the ClientIdentifierReadPlatformService interface.

classes.name: ClientIdentityMapper
classes.description: A private static inner class implementing RowMapper<ClientIdentifierData> for mapping SQL result set rows to ClientIdentifierData objects. It provides the schema() method to generate the SQL SELECT statement and the mapRow() method to map each row to a data object.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of client identifiers for a given client ID, filtered by the current user’s office hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a specific client identifier by client ID and identifier ID, throwing an exception if not found.
